work.description: Allocution LXXVIII creates Jean-Louis Lefebvre de Cheverus (Bordeaux) and Gabriele della Genga Sermattei (Ferrara) cardinal priests; LF13969 → LF13978 across provenance LF13972 (Acta Consistorialia) and page number 96 LF13975; complete through the Trinitarian formula LF14021–14022, before LXXIX LF14025. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is ACTA GREGORII PP. xVi. at LF14054–14054; the source closing at LF14005–14022 reads: Auctoritate omnipotentis Dei, sanctorum apo- stolorum Petri et Pauli ac Nostra creamus S.R.E. presbyteros cardinales -Toannem Le Jebure de Cheverns arch. Burdigalensem Gabrielem Della Genga arch. Ferrariensem Cum dispensationibus, derogationibus et clau- sulis necessariis et opportunis. In nomine Patris®>X, Filii >¥ et Spiritus > Sancti. Amen.
